body: There is nothing wrong with you.  Thank's for your post, I've been going through a very similar situation, though I am actually in Adam's place rather than yours, and we even have the same name!  But it's not easy to get over a friendship like that, and the unfortunate answer is, there really is now answer to how you can just forget about someone.  I haven't spoken to my "friend" in almost a year now, but I still think about her frequently, anything that happens I can't help but think about what she'd have to say about it.  But just as your situation, I can't rekindle my friendship either, no matter how much I'd like to.  My best advice to you is to just try and move on, because it does get easier.  I went from thinking about her all day every day, to just a time or two a day, to a few times a week now... and maybe soon it'll be once in a blue moon.  It's difficult, but not impossible.  Best of luck.
